brief:
Pro-Palestine advocacy has moved beyond university disciplinary measures to criminal prosecution under the Trump administration, Shehab Wire reported. Four cases have entered courtrooms and immigration proceedings, marking an escalation from previous academic pressure on students and faculty supporting Palestinian causes.

The crackdown represents a shift in enforcement strategy. Rather than limiting action to campus-level sanctions, authorities have begun pursuing legal charges and immigration-related proceedings against individuals expressing support for Palestine. The cases signal a widening scope of institutional pressure that now extends into federal courts and immigration enforcement mechanisms.
